section: A — memory truncation fails closed (D-467), on-demand staging probe

probe.mechanism: aws ecs run-task of the existing intellichoice-staging-ops-task definition, same cluster/subnets/security-group/command as the weekly EventBridge schedule intellichoice-staging-memory-consolidate
probe.env_override_rationale: spend guard only. The job's own default is 3000 cents, which is not a bound inside this task's ~120c ceiling; the job's own budget mechanism was tightened, nothing else changed. Guard was NOT reached (students_skipped=0).
probe.window_consolidated: rolling [now-7d, now) as computed by the CLI

invariants.silent_truncation_proof: 0 successful `bedrock_call` records exist in the run's stream, so no call could have stopped on max_tokens and still been counted a success. All 8 attempted calls are matched 1:1 by a `bedrock_call_failed` record AND by a human-readable line naming the max_output_tokens ceiling it hit. 8 attempted = 8 failed = 8 truncations surfaced.
invariants.truncation_reason_observed: OutputTruncatedError — 'model hit max_output_tokens=N before completing the MemoryUpdateResponse response; not retrying under the same ceiling'
invariants.pre_D467_counterfactual: this identical run would have reported added=0, calls_failed=0, exit 0 — the AUD-F-34 silent-zero shape
invariants.provenance: structurally guaranteed and vacuously satisfied here (0 facts written). consolidation.py refuses to write any fact whose model-cited evidence ids do not re-verify against the (student, window) event set: `verified_ids = _verify_evidence(...)` then `if not verified_ids: continue`, and every write site passes `evidence_event_ids=verified_ids`. No DB read or write was performed by this verification.
invariants.circuit_breaker: not tripped — a truncation is a schema-class failure and does not call _record_failure (D-115 blast-radius rule preserved); the run made all 8 attempts

alerting_consequence.note: TRUE POSITIVE, not a false page. Because every model call failed, the CLI exited 1 by design (AUD-F-34), so the intellichoice-staging-ops-task-failed EventBridge rule fired exactly once and sent one SNS notification to intellichoice-staging-alerts.

persistent_data_written: none. 0 facts added and 0 reconfirmed, so no semantic_memory row was created or updated by this probe.

defect_found_report_not_fix.summary: On the real staging cohort at 523b9f0 the D-467 ceiling is still insufficient: 8 of 8 calls truncated and 0 facts were written. Two distinct shapes: (1) student-ext-4 at 1 existing fact got the derived 2688-token ceiling and truncated on all 4 calls; (2) student-ext-1 at ~26 existing facts derived 5888, which the gateway's _HARD_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS capped to 4000 (`bedrock_max_tokens_capped`, `memory_consolidation_payload_oversized`), i.e. past MAX_SAFE_EXISTING_FACTS=11 no ceiling can rescue it — exactly the 'finding under the finding' D-467's own docstring names as needing its own decision.
defect_found_report_not_fix.material_caveat: The 7-day window includes this week's resume-evidence load-test traffic, so 13,872 events dropped over the per-student call cap is far above a normal week (the 2026-08-23 scheduled run: 8 students, 8 calls, 0 dropped, 9 facts added). The saturation is therefore partly a consequence of benchmark-generated event volume, not purely a product regression. Both readings need the next ordinary weekly run to separate them.
defect_found_report_not_fix.what_D467_DID_prove_here: The failure is now loud. Under the pre-fix ordering this run is indistinguishable from 'a quiet week'; under 523b9f0 it exits non-zero, names the ceiling on every call, and pages.
